title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-03-01
source: Source: SBD 2-track reel > DAT > ZA2 > WAVs

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a strong late‑60s/early‑70s show with a standout Dupree's Diamond Blues and a memorable Phil Lesh instrumental, presented with solid audio quality.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that fans describe as clean enough to enjoy the performance. Highlights include an excellent version of "Dupree's Diamond Blues" and a rare 13‑beat Phil Lesh solo, while one reviewer laments the focus on ’60s releases rather than later material.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star comments praise the performance (Dupree's and Phil’s solo) and no audio complaints are noted; a single negative comment concerns release policy, yielding an overall strong but not unanimous endorsement.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific issues mentioned; reviewers imply the soundboard is clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on pacing, but the highlighted moments suggest a well‑received performance.

band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for an unusual 13‑beat instrumental solo around 3:41.
